basics.name: Justin Reeves
basics.label: Deployment systems engineer, automation builder, and customer-facing technical partner
basics.summary: Customer-facing engineer who builds what the field needs. I guide schools and organizations through large Apple deployments, then turn what I learn on those calls into working tools, from AI assistants grounded in real customer data to secure integrations that connect AI to the systems teams already use.

work.name: Apple Inc.
work.summary: Deployment strategy for education and public sector customers, plus the internal tools that support it.
highlights: Guide K-12, higher education, and state and local government customers through large-scale Apple deployments, covering MDM, identity and single sign-on, and zero-touch enrollment.
Consistently deploy customers faster than the team average while carrying a full caseload.

Designed and built an AI-powered browser extension that centralizes case data, email templates, and scheduling. Its AI assistant is grounded in each customer's full history, the deployment process, and the engineer's role. Used daily across the deployment team.
Designed and built Cornerstone, a custom FileMaker Pro platform that connects Calendly, internal systems, and communication tools into a single pane of glass for managing customer engagements.

Engineered a CRM MCP server that gives AI assistants a secure, permissioned connection to customer records, which wasn't previously possible. Also built automation tools with Python, APIs, and Shortcuts adopted across multiple teams.

work.name: Apple Inc.

Partnered with sales teams to remove technical blockers and support customer acquisition strategies.

Provided high-touch support for executives and critical systems.
